sloka: वित्रास्य कारण्डव चक्रवाकान् ।महा रवैः भिन्न कटा गजेन्द्राः ।सरस्सु बद्ध अंबुज भूषणेषुविक्षोभ्य विक्षोभ्य जलम् पिबन्ति ॥४-३०-४०॥
transliteration: vitrāsya kāraṇḍava cakravākān ।mahā ravaiḥ bhinna kaṭā gajendrāḥ ।sarassu baddha aṁbuja bhūṣaṇeṣuvikṣobhya vikṣobhya jalam pibanti ॥4-30-40॥

translations.english: 'The peacocks have shed their ornamental wear, their plumes. They are moving on the river banks miserably, devoid of high spirit as if they are being taunted by flocks of sarasa birds (who are highspinted and cheerful).
translations.hindi: हथिनियाँ काम से विकल, अत्यन्त अनुरागवती, अपने फुड के साथ धीरे धोरे चलती, अपने मतवाले पति हाथी फे पीछे पीछे वन में जा रही हैं
